instruction.name: xvsrari.h
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift of h elements by an immediate.

latencies.notes: vj -> vd; consecutive unrolled copies form a chain. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsrari.h $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvsrari.h $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvsrari.h $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvsrari.h $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvsrari.h $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvsrari.h $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvsrari.h $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvsrari.h $xr7, $xr15, 1
